label: Bible Study
prompt: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and _____ are thy works, Lord God Almighty; just and true are thy ways, thou King of saints.
verse: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvellous are thy works, Lord God Almighty; just and true are thy ways, thou King of saints.
note: The song of Moses and the Lamb — sung beside a sea of glass mingled with fire.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have _____ one to another.
verse: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
note: The world will know Jesus's disciples not by their badges but by how they love one another.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he would fain have filled his belly with the _____ that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.
verse: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.
note: The prodigal son hit bottom wishing he could eat the pigs' husks — and nobody gave him even that.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Then said Saul, I have sinned: return, my son David: for I will no more do thee harm, because my soul was precious in thine eyes this day: behold, I have played the _____, and have erred exceedingly.
verse: Then said Saul, I have sinned: return, my son David: for I will no more do thee harm, because my soul was precious in thine eyes this day: behold, I have played the fool, and have erred exceedingly.
note: Saul's confession after David spared his life a second time — honest words, but it didn't last.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: The righteous shall _____ like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
verse: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
note: The righteous 'flourish like the palm tree' — and two verses later they're still bearing fruit in old age.
